landing_hero_text_subtitle: Personalized support, real-time AI guidance, and caregiver connection to keep you strong and focused—one day at a time.
landing_features_subtitle: We combine science-backed recovery techniques with advanced AI to deliver personalized support when you need it most.
landing_features_card_desc_1: Start and end your day with a compassionate, non-judgmental conversational buddy that tracks triggers and moods.
landing_features_card_desc_2: Earn customized rewards and track progress with interactive, gamified timelines tailored to your recovery path.
landing_features_card_desc_3: Hit the distress button to immediately trigger AI de-escalation scripts, calming prompts, and notification of supporters.
landing_features_card_desc_4: Securely share your sobriety milestones and request assistance from designated allies with complete privacy control.
landing_counter_subtitle: Select a start date to see how the tracker monitors your progress down to the second.
landing_counter_label_input: Choose your sobriety start date & time:
landing_counter_milestone_desc_1: Getting through the first 24 hours is a massive achievement.
landing_counter_milestone_desc_2: 7 days of cleansing your mind and body. You're building momentum.
landing_counter_milestone_desc_3: 30 days sober. New neural pathways are solidifying.
landing_counter_milestone_desc_default: Keep going! You're making progress every single second.
landing_cta_subtitle: You don't have to walk this path alone. Register today and get paired with your digital recovery buddy.
landing_footer_text_tagline: Your daily companion in recovery. Empathetic, private, and always here.
landing_footer_text_copyright: © 2026 SoberBuddy AI. All rights reserved. Created in pair-programming.
landing_chat_demo_subtitle: Click a prompt below to see how SoberBuddy responds:
landing_chat_demo_reply_1: I hear you. Cravings usually peak within 15 minutes. Let's take a deep breath. You've got this, one second at a time.
landing_chat_demo_reply_2: Stress is a known trigger for you. Let's step away from what you're doing. Would listening to music or taking a short walk help right now?
landing_chat_demo_reply_3: Your personalized coping plan lists walking, listening to music, and talking to me. Which one would you like to try first?
